scope: GPU energy of the inference step only. The lean runs measured no power; the host CPU is priced separately as CPU seconds, not as electricity.
busy_interval: generation span of the cell: first scheduler dispatch to the last generation barrier
idle_interval: the rest of the inference service wall: model loading, compilation and waiting for candidate judging
reading: A declared envelope, not a statistical interval. The busy range spans small-batch decoding (low end) to large pooled batches (high end); the idle range is the usual draw of a loaded but idle data-centre GPU. A GPU model that is not listed gets no estimate.
